# brewpage-openapi

Public contract snapshots, documentation and the BrewPage MCP server. The backend-generated public JSON contract is authoritative; this repository distributes deterministic copies.

## What's here

- `openapi/openapi.json` — exported backend-generated public OpenAPI 3.1 contract; version and provenance identify the backend source.
- `openapi/openapi.yaml` — deterministic derived representation; `docs/public/openapi.json` is the identical Scalar copy.
- `mcp-server/` — TypeScript implementation of the BrewPage MCP server. Prepared `version: 1.9.3`. Published as `brewpage-mcp` on npm.
- `docs/` — Astro docs site published at https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/.

## Where to read the live API

- Spec (browser-rendered): https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/api-reference/
- Spec (raw JSON): https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/openapi.json
- Spec (raw YAML): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kochetkov-ma/brewpage-openapi/main/openapi/openapi.yaml
- Live `/v3/api-docs` from production backend: https://brewpage.app/v3/api-docs
- `llms.txt`: https://brewpage.app/llms.txt
- `llms-full.txt`: https://brewpage.app/llms-full.txt

## Recent contract changes

- 1.107.4 (matches backend v1.107.4): contract metadata only. `info.termsOfService`, `info.contact` and top-level `externalDocs` are present again; paths, operations and schemas are the same as in 1.107.2, the first backend-generated snapshot.
- 1.104.0 (matches backend v1.104.0): `POST /api/html` and `PUT /api/html/{ns}/{id}` responses may carry optional `deliveryModeReason` (`auto:<codes>` or `advisory:<codes>`) and `deliveryNotice`, plus `visibilityNotice`. A public page created without `X-Delivery-Mode` may be published on its own subdomain when it needs browser features a BrewPage link does not provide; always use the returned `link`. A repost of already-published content returns the existing page with `200` and `X-Existing-Resource: 1`. `PUT` accepts an optional `format`.
- 1.31.0 (matches backend v1.41.0): `POST /api/html` and `PUT /api/html/{ns}/{id}` accept raw `text/*` and (POST only) `application/octet-stream` bodies. Binary payloads route to `/api/files`. New 422 response with `supportedTypes` array; 415 enriched. See `https://brewpage.app/llms-full.txt`.

## How to use the MCP server

```bash
npx -y brewpage-mcp@1.9.3
```

Always pin an exact version.

The server wraps a subset of REST operations in sixteen tools — read `mcp-server/README.md` for supported inputs and tool list. Omitted REST namespace defaults to `public`; omitted MCP namespace generates an unlisted `priv-*` namespace. Unlisted is readable by anyone with the link unless password-protected. Use explicit `public` only for gallery/search eligibility; protected publications are excluded and unlisted, protected or otherwise ineligible native responses are search-excluded; eligible public HTML, sites and files may permit indexing.

Use the exact returned primary `link`, including root slashes. Send API passwords as `X-Password` and owner authority as `X-Owner-Token` to the configured apex API origin; never send owner tokens to publication hosts. NEW browser password access uses the trusted unlock gateway, without query-password links. HTML API reads return stored rendered HTML or code/text with format-specific MIME; the owner-only source endpoint returns original authored content. Share URLs may provide a viewer.

Default repository limits: HTML 5 MiB; KV values/JSON documents 1 MiB; files/audio 5 MiB, video 20 MiB; sites 20 MiB total, 100 files, 5 MiB per file. TTL defaults to 15 days; ordinary maximum 30 days, with owner-specific caps and possible eligible automatic extensions. Treat returned expiresAt and API validation as authoritative. SDK/CLI modules are proposals, not released clients.

The repository contract/docs license is Apache-2.0; the independently packaged MCP server is MIT. The backend platform remains proprietary.
